text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each product shown its own published beam and diffuse, minus the same product with the Erbs split of its own global irradiance. Points of capacity. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. The x axis spans Figure 1's, for scale. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Exploratory. 6 solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.'
text.tspan: Each product shown its own published beam and diffuse, minus the same product with the Erbs split of its own global irradiance.
Points of capacity. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. The x axis spans Figure 1's, for scale.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Exploratory. 6 solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.
